_comment: Hand-checked verdicts for candidates the automatic resolver got wrong. Name matching alone cannot separate a benchmark from an unrelated project that happens to share its name, so these were verified by opening the repositories on 2026-08-11. `repo` forces a match; `exclude` keeps the entry out of Benchmarks with a stated reason.

Wasp: Benchmarking web agent security ag.why: The resolver matched wasp-lang/wasp, the web framework. The benchmark is Meta's, described in its own repository as 'the WASP web agent security benchmark'.

Agent security bench (asb): Formalizing.why: The resolver matched an unrelated 2-star repository. agiresearch/ASB is the one whose description is 'Agent Security Bench (ASB)'.

Vision-and-Language Navigation: Interpre.why: A capability dataset (R2R) cited as background by the embodied survey, not a trustworthy-AI resource. The resolver matched an awesome-list.

VizWiz Grand Challenge: Answering Visual.why: A visual question answering dataset cited as background, not a safety benchmark. The resolver matched an unrelated challenge submission.
